messages.content: A planetarium reached out to my astrophotography account saying they would love to "make something magical together" and that it could be great exposure for both of us. They have not mentioned a format, what they would provide, or a date.

A plant-based meal-kit company wants two recipe features in my cooking newsletter next month. They say compensation will be a sales bonus through my referral link, but they have not given the commission rate, attribution window, or payout schedule. They also want to reuse the features in their marketing.

{"project_type":"Newsletter sponsorship","requirements":["Company proposes two recipe features in the creator's cooking newsletter next month","Compensation is described as a sales bonus through a referral link","Company wants to reuse the features in its marketing"],"deliverables":["Proposed: two recipe features in the newsletter"],"budget":null,"timeline":"Next month; exact publication dates unspecified","revision_limit":null,"missing_information":["Commission rate and how referrals or sales will be attributed","Payout threshold and schedule","Whether any guaranteed fee is included","Scope, channels and duration of marketing reuse rights","Recipe topics, product details and approval process"],"assumptions":[],"clarifying_questions":["What commission rate and referral attribution window will apply?","When and how will referral earnings be reported and paid, and is there a guaranteed fee?","Which marketing channels may use the features, and for how long?","What recipe topics and meal-kit details should the features cover?","What are the target publication dates and approval steps?"]}

A ceramics studio offered me $900 to make one 45-second TikTok showing its glazing process and one portrait photo of the finished vase. They want permission to use both pieces in paid ads and on their website forever. We have not agreed whether the fee includes those rights. The posts are planned for six weeks from now.

I'm a book reviewer and an independent publisher wants a launch partnership for a new historical novel. They can pay $500 and want me to help create buzz before the release on March 12, but they haven't said what posts or other content they expect.

A regional outdoor festival wants me to film its opening day, interview three performers, edit a two-minute recap, deliver ten vertical clips, and post a photo carousel. They first contacted me this morning and say every file must be approved and ready by tomorrow at noon. The festival begins tonight, and no fee has been discussed.
